bear_case.title: China dominates cells
bear_case.description: CATL (40.2%) and BYD (14.4%) hold over half of global EV/storage battery shipments through May 2026; in China's domestic market alone CATL held 42.70% and BYD 18.49% as of June, and seven Chinese firms control 72.2% of the global market. GlobalData sees installed global BESS capacity rising sixfold, 224.8 GW to 1,300 GW, by 2030 — with the US and China holding a combined 74.6% share. Western integrators compete on software and services, not hardware cost.

bear_case.title: Policy whiplash
bear_case.description: Section 301 duties on non-EV lithium-ion (grid BESS) cells jumped from 7.5% to 25% effective Jan 1, 2026, pushing the effective combined US import tariff on Chinese ESS batteries to ~58.4% (from 40.9%); new FEOC rules cap Chinese-sourced content at 45% of manufacturing cost for ITC eligibility.

bear_case.title: Margin compression
bear_case.description: Tesla's own Q2 print is fresh evidence: energy-segment margin nearly halved QoQ (39.5% → 20.4%) on a warranty charge and a lapsed tariff benefit, plus falling industrial-storage ASPs. Software attach remains the differentiator for integrators.

bear_case.title: Solid-state timelines
bear_case.description: QuantumScape's Honda pact and Straubel board addition are votes of confidence, but the company is still burning ~$65M/quarter with $859M liquidity that analysts say must last until "late this decade" before meaningful revenue arrives.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: GE Vernova
positions.note: Grid equipment is the actual bottleneck — storage does not matter if there is nothing to connect it to. Overlaps your Nuclear sleeve.

positions.name: Tesla
positions.note: Megapack is the most profitable, fastest-growing part of Tesla and is priced as though it barely exists. You must accept the car business alongside it.

positions.name: Fluence Energy
positions.note: The clearest listed grid-scale storage pure-play, with the margin pressure that comes from competing on hardware.

positions.name: Eos Energy
positions.note: Zinc-based chemistry sidesteps the lithium supply chain entirely — if it can manufacture at cost and at scale, which is unproven.

positions.name: QuantumScape
positions.note: Solid-state batteries would reset the whole sector. Fifteen years in, still no commercial cell.

positions.name: Enphase
positions.note: Structurally impaired by US residential-solar policy changes. This is a different problem from the storage thesis and it has not been solved.

positions.name: Stem Inc
positions.note: Repeated restructurings and a software story that has not converted into durable revenue.
